name: Aegon's Conquest
description: Aegon the Conqueror invaded and successfully unified six of the Seven Kingdoms of Westeros under his banner.

name: The Dance of the Dragons
description: A bloody civil war in the Targaryen Dynasty for the Iron Throne, between Rhaenyra and Aegon II for succession upon their father's death.

name: The Blackfyre Rebellion
description: Bastard son Daemon Blackfyre disputes the succession of Daeron II, leading to a large scale war.

name: Robert's Rebellion
description: Robert Baratheon along with Lords Jon Arryn and Eddard Stark led a rebellion against House Targaryen.

name: Discovery of dragon eggs
description: Daenerys Targaryen receives three dragon eggs as a wedding gift.

name: War of The Five Kings
description: Following King Robert I's death, five men claim Kingship leading to a war.

name: The Red Wedding
description: Robb Stark, his mother, and most of his bannermen are murdered at Edmure Tully's wedding.

name: Resurrection of Jon Snow
description: After being murdered by his own men, Jon Snow is resurrected by Melisandre.

name: Battle of the Bastards
description: Jon Snow retakes Winterfell from Ramsay Bolton.

name: The destruction of the Iron Throne
description: Daenerys Targaryen is killed by Jon Snow, and the Iron Throne is melted by the dragon Drogon.
